title: hello_ack (hub -> agent)
description: Reply to hello (correlation_id = hello id). If accepted=false the hub closes the socket with code 4003 after sending this; the agent backs off and retries (see protocol.md).

reason.description: Set when accepted=false: cert_revoked | node_removed | node_unknown | protocol_unsupported | hub_draining.

config_version.description: Current config version on the hub; a config_push follows immediately when it differs from hello.config_version.

min_agent_version.description: Informational. Updates are driven by the control plane with stage_update / apply_update (protocol.md §14); agents never update on their own.

drain.description: True when the node is in draining/drained state: the agent must keep serving current instances but accept no load_model.

features.description: Optional protocol features this hub accepts (added 2026-11-23): observed_engines (hello/inventory.observed_engines, EngineSample.observed) and gpu_processes (GpuSample.processes). Agents send those fields only when the hub lists them, so a newer agent keeps working with an older hub; unknown names are ignored. Since 2026-11-24: secure_transport (hello.proxy.mode / bind, event kind ingress_rejected, config_push.security) and agent_updates (hello/inventory.agent_update, event kind agent_update, commands stage_update / apply_update, security policy release keys; protocol.md §14).
